hints.text: The mean is the equal share each value would get if the total were split evenly.
The five values add to $10 + 20 + 30 + 40 + 50 = 150$. Divide that total by $5$.
$150 \div 5 = 30$, so the mean of the set is $30$.

explanation: Add the five values to get the total: $10 + 20 + 30 + 40 + 50 = 150$.
The set has $5$ values, so divide the total by $5$.
$150 \div 5 = 30$, so the mean of the set is $30$.
